data.one_liner: A customizable curved bottom navigation bar with an animated notch and elastic FAB bubble.
data.what_it_does: Provides a curved bottom navigation bar widget featuring a smooth animated notch, gliding elastic FAB bubble, notification badges, labels, built-in style presets, and support for icons, Lottie, SVG, or custom widgets.
use_when: You want a modern, curved bottom navigation bar with fluid animations.
You need built-in style presets and extensive customization over bar geometry and colors.
You require notification badges on specific navigation items.
avoid_when: You need a standard Material Design bottom navigation bar without custom curves.
You prefer platform-native navigation styles like Cupertino tab bars on iOS.
strengths: Smooth animated notch and elastic FAB bubble transitions.
Comprehensive built-in presets and high customizability.
Supports Lottie, SVG, images, and custom widgets for icons alongside notification badges.
weaknesses: Limited to bottom navigation bar use cases.
May require tuning parameters manually to fit certain screen sizes or layouts perfectly.
data.setup_notes: Pure Dart and Flutter implementation; requires no CocoaPods, native iOS SPM, or AGP configuration steps.
data.minimal_example:
CurvedNavigationBarPro(
  items: const [
    CurvedNavigationItemPro(
      inactiveIcon: Icons.home_outlined,
      activeIcon: Icons.home_rounded,
      label: 'Home',
    ),
    CurvedNavigationItemPro(
      inactiveIcon: Icons.favorite_outline,
      activeIcon: Icons.favorite_rounded,
      label: 'Saved',
    ),
  ],
  currentIndex: _index,
  onTap: (i) => setState(() => _index = i),
)
